comment: Validation runs X0 (md/PLAN.md, stage S4, gate G-V; entry of 6 Oct 2026, 9:15 PM IST, points 1 and 2; md/PRODUCTION.md): 5 ns from the crystal pose with the full protocol of md/protocol.json, one for each zinc set that is simulated (md/RUN.md: a second zinc model has its own X0). X0_2s is the validation run of the Seminario set, which the plan makes the primary set if it passes gate G-Z and gate G-V; X0_2e is that of the empirical set, the primary set if 2s fails and the zinc sensitivity set otherwise. X0_2e waits for X0_2s, so the two run one after the other in this order, also after a restart. Both gates are judged on the Pi from the pulled runs (md/analysis, both programs); the runner cannot judge a gate, and no production task is in this file. Time limit of one attempt: one hour (a run takes about 15 minutes).

tasks.title: validation run X0 of zinc set 2s (Seminario): 5 ns from the crystal pose (gates G-Z and G-V)
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/bonded_2s/X0/manifest.json" run_id=X0 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=5 test_only=false

tasks.title: validation run X0 of zinc set 2e (empirical): 5 ns from the crystal pose (gates G-Z and G-V)
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/bonded_2e/X0/manifest.json" run_id=X0 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=5 test_only=false
